name: 52etf-webmcp
title: 52etf.net — Objective Economic, Crypto, Commodity & Real Estate Data Cache
description: 52etf.net 常用经济指标缓存、Crypto链上多空、房地产观测与有效连接汇总 (Cloudflare Agent / WebMCP / SEO 友好站点 — 仅客观数据与连接呈现，不含任何评论或个人资产透露)

rate_limits.recommended_strategy: Prefer fetching /llms-full.txt or /index.json in a single HTTP GET request instead of crawling all 29 pages concurrently.

tools.name: search_indicators
tools.description: Search cached economic, commodity, bond, FX, real estate, crypto, and equity indicators by keyword, category section, or tag.

query.description: Keyword or fuzzy search query (e.g., 'M2', 'Hyperliquid', 'AHR999', 'TSLA', '粮食', '住户贷款')

tag.description: Optional tag filter without leading # (e.g., 'BTC', 'M1', '美联储')

include_stale.description: Whether to include indicators not updated for >180 days (default: true)

tools.name: get_indicator_detail
tools.description: Retrieve full cached Markdown content, formulas, primary/backup URLs, and staleness status for a specific indicator by slug, title, or URL.

slug_or_url.description: Indicator slug (e.g. 'crypto-hyperliquid-onchain-long-short'), path, or title substring

tools.name: get_stale_or_broken_links
tools.description: Get all indicators not updated for >180 days (highlighted red on site) and the latest CI /404.txt link verification summary.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all 6 indicator categories with item counts, stale counts, and Markdown twin URLs.

calibration_protocol.description: External agents with GitHub write access can calibrate cached numbers or replace dead links by editing content/<section>/<slug>.md and running node scripts/check-links.mjs.
